# assets

Host, operating-system and generic assets.

- Toolset name: `assets`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 13 (6 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_asset_host`

**Create host asset** · mutating

Create a host asset by IP address or hostname. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `value` | string | yes | IP address or hostname of the host |

### `openvas_delete_asset`

**Delete generic asset** · destructive

Delete a generic asset of any type (no trashcan).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_delete_asset_host`

**Delete host asset** · destructive

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_delete_operating_system`

| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

| `id` | string | yes | Asset UUID |
| `type` | string | yes | Asset type: host, os or tls_certificate |

### `openvas_list_asset_hosts`

**List host assets** · read-only

List host assets discovered by scans, with highest severity and OS.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_list_assets`

**List generic assets** · read-only

List assets of one type (`host`, `os` or `tls_certificate`) through the generic asset catalog.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |
| `type` | string | yes | Asset type: host, os or tls_certificate |

### `openvas_list_operating_systems`

### `openvas_update_asset`

**Update generic asset** · destructive

Update a generic asset's comment (type required for the read-back). Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | New comment |
| `id` | string | yes | Asset UUID |
| `type` | string | yes | Asset type: host, os or tls_certificate |
